missing_information_behavior: Do not apply the positive scoring rule when either required answer is missing; ask for clarification or return insufficient information.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer B12 deficiency from diet pattern or symptoms alone.
Current B12 supplement use must be checked before a new recommendation.
Pregnancy/lactation, known deficiency, malabsorption, relevant medication use or abnormal laboratory results require appropriate professional assessment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Current treatment or abnormal laboratory findings
population_and_context: Vegan dietary pattern with low or absent fortified-food intake; not a diagnosis of deficiency.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose supported by this rule. Existing deep-record BASIC dose logic remains reference_only; treatment requires professional assessment where deficiency or absorption issue is suspected.
certainty_and_limitations: Claim and rule remain draft; certainty not assessed in this record. The current ODS source must be extracted and appraised before activation.
